stem:
Tara learns Gumulgal number names: urapon means 1 and ukasar means 2. Longer names are built as sums of these group words, so ukasar-urapon means 3 and ukasar-ukasar means 4.

Which reading of ukasar-ukasar-urapon is correct?

options.text: The name means urapon, because urapon is the last word printed.
The name is just a new unrelated label, ignoring the known meanings of 1 and 2.
The name means 5, because it is 2 + 2 + 1.
Treating the parts as independent labels is what builds the total.

teacher.key_rationale: Repeated group words plus leftovers give the total: ukasar-ukasar-urapon = 2+2+1 = 5. Taking only the last word swaps the name. Dropping the 1-and-2 rule omits the structure. Independent labels reverse how the total is built.

mx_swap.reason: Scope-error CWO excludes forming names above 6; this stem stays at 5, so kept term_substitution, condition_omission, relationship_reversal.
